visualProgression.COMMON: Dirty, faded and matte with clearly visible residual dry earth clumps, grit and smears adhering to the fossil.
visualProgression.UNCOMMON: Weathered and imperfect with dust and sediment; moderately faded but clearer than common.
visualProgression.RARE: Meticulously clean and premium, with controlled natural colour rather than oversaturation.
